record.question: How does foetal haemoglobin differ from adult haemoglobin?
options: HbF has a lower affinity for oxygen than HbA
HbF has a higher affinity for oxygen than HbA
HbF is composed of two alpha and two beta globin chains
HbF production is crucial for adult life
record.explanation: Answer B: HbF has a higher affinity for oxygen than HbA. Fetal hemoglobin binds 2,3-BPG less strongly than adult hemoglobin, shifting its oxygen dissociation curve left and increasing oxygen affinity. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK500011/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK2263/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
